title: Cosmetic TNT
description: Fake TNT blocks used cosmetically that dont blow up or ignite
body:
# Cosmetic TNT!
If you have ever wanted a cosmetic version of TNT that does not risk your precious build getting destroyed look no further!


Q: How do i obtain cosmetic TNT?

A: Its easily crafted in any crafting grid with a shapeless recipe of just a glass block and a TNT block


Q: Is there a tool that is made to break the block?

A: Yes! it is recomended to use a pickaxe since the host block is a loadstone for various reasons


Q: I think i found a bug what do i do now?

A: Most things should not be an issue as ive tested the pack pretty well for any bugs. However if you do believe u have found something please contact me on discord. Note: The TNT looking bright in a dark room when it is daytime is not a bug but simply a limitation of block display entities


Q: Can i make all TNT not explode somehow?

A: Yes this is actually a gamerule from 1.21.5+. If you are playing a lower version of minecraft try my recreation of the gamerule as a datapack [here!](https://modrinth.com/project/zfvnhhs8)

Q: Will u update this in the future?

A: Yes i alrd have small changes planned but i dont know when i have the motivation to make them happen. But a 2.0 will prob happen! with small changes
